perplexity.description:
Country Music – A Film By Ken Burns (The Soundtrack), released in 2019 by Legacy Recordings, is a comprehensive collection that captures the rich tapestry of American country music as explored in Ken Burns’s acclaimed documentary series. Featuring over 100 tracks across its deluxe 5CD edition and more than 40 on the standard 2CD release, the album spans the genre’s evolution from early Appalachian folk and “hillbilly” recordings to bluegrass, honky-tonk, rockabilly, and modern country. The compilation includes seminal performances by legendary artists such as The Carter Family, Jimmie Rodgers, Hank Williams, Johnny Cash, Loretta Lynn, Willie Nelson, Dolly Parton, and many others, reflecting the diverse roots and stylistic breadth of country music.

As a soundtrack album, it stands as a significant entry in Legacy Recordings’ catalog, serving both as a companion to the documentary and as a standalone historical survey of the genre. The album’s musical style is rooted in traditional country, folk, and Americana, with select tracks bridging into gospel, blues, and early rock influences, illustrating country music’s deep connections to broader American musical traditions. Upon release, the soundtrack was widely praised for its curation and historical scope, reaching No. 1 on Billboard’s Soundtrack Album Sales chart and selling over 39,000 copies in the United States by March 2020. Its commercial success and critical acclaim underscore its importance as both a cultural document and a definitive anthology of country music’s most iconic recordings.
